//pnpm-overrides: The tree resolved two @types/react (18.3.27 and 19.2.4). React's own types declare the Component class, so two copies mean two structurally incompatible Components, and every third-party component typed against the other one fails TS2786 ('cannot be used as a JSX component' / 'Property refs is missing'). That is what made `pnpm type-check` red across CameraView, Svg, QRCode and GiftedChat. bobo-app runs react 18.3.1, so the types are pinned to match the runtime.
